verdict.rationale: LightSprint lets teams save skill files such as design.md for the design system and review.md for code standards, which every teammate or AI agent can pull from (docs-13). These come from a one-click skills library (docs-24), and the vendor claims shipped changes fit the patterns the team already uses (docs-32). missing for 10: in-depth docs on file format, location and scope (e.g. a repo-level conventions file), explicit evidence that these files shape plan generation as well as code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
